sloka: उवाचेदं वचो राजा देवेन्द्रमिव काश्यपः ।ज्येष्ठायामसि मे पत्न्यां सदृश्यां सदृशः सुतः ॥२-३-३९॥
transliteration: uvācedaṁ vaco rājā devendramiva kāśyapaḥ ।jyeṣṭhāyāmasi me patnyāṁ sadṛśyāṁ sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ ॥2-3-39॥

translations.english: A worthy son of my worthy eldest wife, O Rama, your great virtues have endeared you to me.
